mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.updated_at FROM blog_article a INNER JOIN blog_category category ON category.id = a.category_id AND category.level = 2 AND category.status = 'ENABLED' INNER JOIN blog_category parent ON parent.id = category.parent_id AND parent.level = 1 AND parent.status = 'ENABLED' INNER JOIN blog_user author ON author.id = a.author_id WHERE a.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY a.published_at DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{articleId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE blog_article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{articleId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE blog_article SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{articleId} AND like_count > 0
